projects.notes: Statewide multipoint layer behind Caltrans' SB1/IIJA infrastructure project map (owner DRISI.SB1). Covers SHOPP, STIP, local streets and roads, transit, rail, plus non-transportation items (broadband, water, energy): filter ProjectType='Transportation' and, for state highway work, IsOnSHS or Program like 'State Highway Operations & Protection Program%' / 'State Transportation Improvement Program'. Planned = ProjectStatus 'Planned' (also 'To be announced'); 'In Progress' = under way; 'Completed' = done. EstStartDate/EstEndDate are epoch ms and often null. Geometry is points only (no alignment). Category and Agency also useful. DateUpdated is a text field in mixed formats.

projects.notes: Line layer from Caltrans' PRSM project system, but ONLY Districts 1, 2 and 3 (northern California); service name is prefixed DEV_ so it may be renamed. source_date was 10/06/2026. project_phase: PID/PrePID = initiation, PAED = environmental/approval, PSE = final design (all pre-construction), Construction, Closeout. m500_date and m600_date are Caltrans milestone dates stored as text M/D/YYYY (not interpreted here: confirm their meaning before using as a letting date). program_category separates shopp / STIP / MINOR-A etc.; subprogram gives asset type. county is the 2-3 letter Caltrans county code.

projects_note: No single statewide Caltrans line layer of programmed (SHOPP/STIP) projects was found on the Caltrans GIS server (caltrans-gis.dot.ca.gov, whole directory listed) or its ArcGIS Online org. District-level layers also exist (e.g. District 5 SHOPP_PID_Map, last updated 2024) but were not recorded as they are partial and older.
parcels_statewide_note: null: California has no free statewide parcel layer with owner names. Owner names are withheld from public GIS layers under California Government Code 7928.205 (cited in San Bernardino County's own layer).
parcels_counties_note: None usable. Checked: Los Angeles County parcel service (cache.gis.lacounty.gov/.../LACounty_Parcel/MapServer/0, 2.43M records) has no owner field; San Bernardino County (services.arcgis.com/aA3snZwJfFkVyDuP/.../Parcels_for_San_Bernardino_County/FeatureServer/0, 840k records) has an OwnerName field but every record reads 'Protected Per CA Gov Code 7928.205' (0 records otherwise). No owner-bearing county layer found for San Diego, Orange or Riverside. Second pass 2026-11-17 (see parcels_counties_checked): ten counties checked by live request and none publishes owner names. Riverside (PARCELS_CREST) and Alameda publish the owner's MAILING ADDRESS without a name; Los Angeles, Fresno, Santa Cruz, Sacramento, San Diego, Orange and Kern publish neither; San Bernardino masks the name. All ten layers answer point+distance spatial queries.
summary: Projects: statewide coverage only as points (Caltrans SB1/IIJA project map, 32k records with status and cost); a line layer with phases exists for Districts 1-3 only. Parcels: no owner names available statewide or in the five largest counties (redacted under CA Gov Code 7928.205).
